dimensions.mission: Ordinary OPPORTUNITY_EPISODES entry is no longer blocked by a provably different-market historical reservation; the canonical reproducer moves from a masked STOP to START with computed budget.
dimensions.flexibility_and_history: Append-only history untouched; the borrowed basis is ephemeral and read-only; rollback is a reader revert with no data change.
dimensions.context_efficiency: Three functions changed in existing owners; compact tests in four existing modules; no new subsystem.
dimensions.research_truth: Same-market occupancy and publication-only republish keep spent budget; unresolved continuity still STOPs; the selection caveat is preserved as a warning, never erased.
dimensions.owner_operability: JSON and CLI show the real STOP reason and one next action; proof provenance in search_budget; operator doc updated.
dimensions.execution_to_cashflow: Unblocks the next metadata/admission step only; no scientific look, alpha or cashflow claim.
dimensions.monitoring_and_recovery: Unknown or contradictory proof stays a typed STOP with existing PROVE_MARKET_CONTINUITY guidance.
dimensions.build_vs_buy: WRAP existing shared reader and versioned validator; no dependency, registry, cache or service.
dimensions.security: No credentials, provider, VPS or deploy; read-only real-data reproducer.
dimensions.red_team: Mutation controls: removing own-history guard, recompute guard, version check or STOP precedence each fails a test.

capability_radar.now: NONE: existing reader, validator, store and CLI suffice.
capability_radar.watch: Merged-reader read-only check on the actual corpus after the pinned I4 path; borrowed-proof CLI line only if owners need it.

recovery: Ordinary Git revert of the reader; historical records, receipts and real reservations are never modified.
